normal.text: Gamers are quick to complain about prices, but are we paying attention to everything else? LeRon calls on the whole “nation of gamers” to keep a closer eye on the industry. If we’re ready to call out the cost of games and hardware, he says, we should be just as ready to call out shady practices. We should also look at how we treat these companies and their employees. #GamingIndustry #GamingCommunity #GamingTakes #VideoGames #BossRushPodcast

normal.text: Last night I explored other Dig Dugs worth playing. I know the Famicom game is good as I've played that a lot, same applies to the 2600 game. I tried two really cool versions of Dig Dug for the #C64 1) Dig Dug (C64) by LC-Games (2024) - Faithful arcade port 2) Dig Dug +6DH Special Enhanced by Hokuto Force (2022) - An improved version of the original Atarisoft/Datasoft C64 port. There's also a version of the LC game called Revival with procedurally generated levels. #Retrogaming

normal.name: Computer Chronicles Revisited
normal.text: With all the TGA chatter, let’s look back 40 years to the first Software Publishers Association “Excellence in Software” Awards. The SPA equivalent of GOTY in 1986 was “Best Entertainment Product,” which went to ICOM Simulations’ “Déjà Vu,” a Mac point-and-click adventure published by Mindscape. “Déjà Vu” beat out “Hacker” (Activision), “Ultima IV” (Origin Systems), “King’s Quest II” (Sierra On-Line), “Airborne” (Silicon Beach), and “NFL Challenge” (Xor Corporation). #apple #retrogaming
